subject.title: Silent empty tool results in long-running Sonnet 5 sessions after a large tool result

question: Should maintainers accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524 as the fix path for this issue, or require an installed long-session repro/proof before merge?
rationale: The source-level gap and candidate regression are clear, but the fix changes saturated-session prompt recovery priority and the exact field scenario still lacks fresh installed-session proof.

options.title: Refresh and land candidate PR
options.body: Use the existing focused PR after conflict resolution if maintainers accept helper-level proof plus field reports for the fresh-output priority tradeoff.

options.title: Require installed-session proof
options.body: Pause landing until a redacted WebChat, Discord, or similar long-session run demonstrates the empty-result scenario and the candidate fix in a real setup.

options.title: Hold for broader root-cause work
options.body: Keep this issue open as a broader investigation if maintainers believe the cross-provider reports imply more than the prompt-projection gap.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land candidate PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused PR after conflict resolution if maintainers accept helper-level proof plus field reports for the fresh-output priority tradeoff.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent merged fresh-result protection that the candidate PR extends.
